verdict: Google is consuming most of your budget and returning almost nothing.
narrative: In the last 28 days, Google Ads spent $2,747 and produced 2 conversions — a cost of roughly $1,373 each — while Meta delivered all 31 leads at $47 per lead. Google's search campaign is confirmed as the primary drag on your overall efficiency, pulling your blended cost per lead up to $135.76. We are actively reallocating budget away from Google search to protect lead volume while that campaign is evaluated. In parallel, your pipeline shows 31 paid leads arriving but zero appointments booked, which points to an intake gap that needs to close before more lead volume will translate to cases. Expect a corrected spend split and a direct conversation about the intake process in the coming week.
